arguments.name: currencyCode
arguments.description: The unique code identifier for the currency (e.g., "000008")

raw.name: currencyCode
raw.description: The unique code identifier for the currency (e.g., "000008")

arguments.name: currencyName
arguments.description: The full or partial name of the currency to search for (e.g., "Dollar", "Euro")

raw.name: currencyName
raw.description: The full or partial name of the currency to search for (e.g., "Dollar", "Euro")

arguments.name: currencySymbol
arguments.description:
The currency symbol to search for (e.g., "AUD," "USD"); 
NOTE: currencySymbol is not currency symbol like "$"; it is a combination of letters "USD."

raw.name: currencySymbol
raw.description:
The currency symbol to search for (e.g., "AUD," "USD"); 
NOTE: currencySymbol is not currency symbol like "$"; it is a combination of letters "USD."

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: Defines how currency types are retrieved. Case-insensitive. Values like “show all”, “all”, “list of all”, “all existing”, “existing”, or “available” return all records across all pages. “Search” (default) filters results using code, name, or symbol.
